issues: Demo choice: the test only runs the TFRecord preparation helper (data/tfrecord.py), a data-wrangling script. The README's runnable model demo is 'Single-Label Image Classification' (./example/image_classification.sh with the ResNet-101 checkpoint), plus feature extraction; neither is tested, so a broken model/inference path passes.

The examiner's reason for skipping it ('checkpoint demos rely on Google Drive/Baidu links and Python 2.7/TF1') is not an eligibility criterion: the Google Drive file is public and downloadable without an account (ckpt-resnet101-mlimages-imagenet.zip, 475 MB, served with confirm=t), and the probe agent already built a Python 2.7 + TF1 environment for tfrecord.py.

The model runs on CPU as shipped: flags.py:42 data_format defaults to 'channels_first', which resnet.py:40 does not treat as 'NCHW', so the graph is NHWC; gpu_options in image_classification.py:66-70 are ignored without a GPU.
